summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of FinSight AI-powered personal finance tracker. All backend APIs (28/28) and frontend functionality (14/14) verified successfully. Minor chart rendering warnings detected but do not affect functionality.

design_issues.issue: Chart width/height warnings during initial render (-1 dimensions)
design_issues.impact: Console warnings only, charts render correctly after initial load
design_issues.recommendation: Add explicit minWidth/minHeight or aspect ratio to chart containers

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/signup creates user, seeds sample data, returns JWT (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login authenticates and returns JWT (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns current user with Bearer token (200)
Backend: PATCH /api/auth/me updates name and base_currency (200)
Backend: GET /api/transactions returns seeded transactions (40 items)
Backend: POST /api/transactions creates transaction with manual category
Backend: POST /api/transactions auto-categorizes via Gemini AI (Transport)
Backend: PATCH /api/transactions/{id} updates transaction amount
Backend: DELETE /api/transactions/{id} deletes transaction
Backend: GET /api/transactions?type=expense filters by type
Backend: POST /api/ai/categorize suggests category via Gemini (Food & Drink)
Backend: POST /api/receipts/scan extracts receipt data (merchant, amount, category)
Backend: GET /api/budgets returns seeded budgets (5 items)
Backend: POST /api/budgets creates budget with upsert logic
Backend: PATCH /api/budgets/{id} updates budget limit
Backend: DELETE /api/budgets/{id} deletes budget
Backend: GET /api/bills returns seeded bills (5 items)
Backend: POST /api/bills creates recurring bill
Backend: PATCH /api/bills/{id} updates bill amount
Backend: DELETE /api/bills/{id} deletes bill
Backend: GET /api/goals returns seeded goals (3 items)
Backend: POST /api/goals creates savings goal
Backend: POST /api/goals/{id}/contribute increments current_amount
Backend: PATCH /api/goals/{id} updates goal target_amount
Backend: DELETE /api/goals/{id} deletes goal
Backend: GET /api/dashboard returns aggregated data (KPIs, trend, budgets, bills, goals)
Backend: GET /api/meta/categories returns categories and currencies
Frontend: Landing page loads with hero, feature grid, and CTAs
Frontend: Signup flow creates account and redirects to /app dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard displays KPI cards (Income, Expense, Net, Savings Rate)
Frontend: Navigation sidebar links work (Dashboard, Transactions, Budgets, Bills, Goals, Settings)
Frontend: Transactions page loads and displays seeded data
Frontend: Budgets page displays 5 budget cards with progress bars
Frontend: Bills page displays 5 recurring bills with due date badges
Frontend: Goals page displays 3 savings goals with progress and contribution buttons
Frontend: Settings page displays profile form (email, name, base currency, logout)
Frontend: Dark theme applied consistently (bg: rgb(13, 16, 23))
Frontend: Tabular numbers styling present for financial data
Frontend: No critical error messages detected on any page
Frontend: Multi-currency support visible (USD/EUR/GBP/INR/JPY)
Frontend: Seeded data loads immediately after signup (40 transactions, 5 budgets, 5 bills, 3 goals)
